Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misunderstood the task and prematurely marked it complete without engaging any specialist. It provided an incorrect explanation (claiming moisture was absorbed/expelled by the glass and invoking a non-physical “reverse water clarity”) and mislabeled it as option C, instead of clearly identifying the correct mechanism—ambient water vapor condensing on the cold glass surface. This reflects both a procedural error (skipping required steps) and a conceptual error (faulty scientific reasoning/mismatched option text).
